plugins/smartclim/plugin_info/configurat.Adresse e-mail du compte AUX Home (celle: Email address of the AUX Home account (the one used in the mobile app)
plugins/smartclim/plugin_info/configurat.Mot de passe du compte AUX Home. Il est: Password of the AUX Home account. It is stored encrypted and never logged.
plugins/smartclim/plugin_info/configurat.Code pays ISO à 3 lettres (FRA, BEL, CHE: 3-letter ISO country code (FRA, BEL, CHE, DEU…). Pre-filled from Jeedom's time zone; outside Europe, enter it manually. An incorrect country will cause the connection to the AUX Home cloud to fail.
plugins/smartclim/plugin_info/configurat.Sans pays valide — ni saisi, ni déduit d: Without a valid country — neither entered manually nor derived from Jeedom's time zone — no connection to the cloud is attempted.
plugins/smartclim/plugin_info/configurat.Entre 1 et 1440 minutes, 5 minutes par d: Between 1 and 1440 minutes, 5 minutes by default.
plugins/smartclim/plugin_info/configurat.La température ambiante remontée par AUX: The room temperature reported by AUX Home refreshes slowly (up to about 30 minutes); reducing this interval does not speed up the data.
plugins/smartclim/plugin_info/configurat.Le test utilise les identifiants enregis: The test uses the saved credentials: save your changes before testing.
plugins/smartclim/plugin_info/configurat.Le test n'a pas répondu à temps: The test did not respond in time
plugins/smartclim/plugin_info/configurat.Effacer l'e-mail et le mot de passe du c: Clear the email and password of the AUX Home account?
plugins/smartclim/plugin_info/configurat.Erreur de communication avec le serveur: Error communicating with the Jeedom server

plugins/smartclim/core/ajax/smartclim.aj.Erreur interne du plugin — consultez les: Internal plugin error — check the logs

plugins/smartclim/core/class/smartclim.c.Connexion réussie au compte AUX Home: Successfully connected to the AUX Home account
plugins/smartclim/core/class/smartclim.c.Échec de la connexion — vérifiez vos ide: Connection failed — check your credentials and the selected country
plugins/smartclim/core/class/smartclim.c.Service AUX Home injoignable, réessayez: AUX Home service unreachable, please try again later
plugins/smartclim/core/class/smartclim.c.Réponse inattendue du service AUX Home —: Unexpected response from the AUX Home service — check the plugin logs
plugins/smartclim/core/class/smartclim.c.Le service AUX Home a refusé la requête: The AUX Home service rejected the initial request — check the country code (FRA, BEL…)
plugins/smartclim/core/class/smartclim.c.Erreur interne lors de la préparation de: Internal error while preparing the connection — check the plugin logs
plugins/smartclim/core/class/smartclim.c.Compte AUX Home non configuré : renseign: AUX Home account not configured: enter the email and password
plugins/smartclim/core/class/smartclim.c.Pays du compte AUX Home introuvable : sa: AUX Home account country not found: enter the 3-letter ISO code (FRA, BEL…) in the Country field
